curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with why an unlicensed driver needs a permit before the drive test, then the four proofs an application carries and where REAL ID and voter questions go.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per proof; a contrast card that gives each of the four proofs its own job.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a document problem and asks which proof solves it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the ordered permit steps: the application, documents and fee, then the knowledge and vision tests.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step in order; contrast cards separating paperwork from the two tests.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that asks which step comes next or which item is a test.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the minimum permit age for minors, driver education, the parent signature, when the permit becomes usable, and how to check a driving school instructor.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per teen permit rule, with the age and signature rules kept apart.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz built on a teen applicant scenario.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who may supervise practice, the drive test that still follows the permit, and the age, holding time, training and practice-hour rules a minor must meet.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each requirement; contrast cards for adult versus minor supervisors, education versus training, and the teen age ladder.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the ages, months and hours of the teen ladder.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the provisional license and its three bans on late-night driving, young passengers and paid or commercial driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per ban plus a contrast card listing all three.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a teen trip and asking whether it is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Match each exception to the person who must sign its note, then show how a parent or guardian can cancel a teen license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each exception note and the cancellation form; a contrast card pairing each exception with its signer.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names an exception and asks who signs the note.

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
